{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''Alliance freighter''' served as the impetus for the young [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], carrying a group of Rebels, including the wounded [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|special operative]] [[Jan Ors]], and stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fuel slug/Legends|fuel slugs]], docked with the Datch family-owned [[Pellezara station]] in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] for maintenance while on the run from Imperial pursuit. Tarrin, while working on the freighter, eventually uncovered the vessel's affiliation. Knowing he could not let the stolen cargo fall back into Imperial hands, Datch commandeered the freighter while its Rebel crew, save for Ors, was still aboard the station, and helped it reach Rebel sanctuary. Datch then decided to leave his life on Pellezara station behind and went on to enlist in the Rebel cause himself.
